disclaimer: PLACEHOLDER PARAMETERS - synthetic mechanisms, not measured TVs.

format.transfer: linear absolute channel intensities; neutral R=G=B=N represents N cd/m²
format.colorimetry_status: P preview interpretation: the simulator has synthetic RGB matrices, no calibrated gamut or spectral model
format.pq_source_note: Procedural RGB nits use PQ per-channel for pipeline input only; PQ transfer does not imply BT.2020 primaries.
format.presentation: No SDR exposure, OETF or per-TV normalization is baked into assets. Browser mapping is a separate transform.

temporal_protocol.history: One persistent response/load pipeline per profile; pre-roll holds the initial source, then frame i advances i*8 pixels with wrap.
temporal_protocol.observer: Synthetic horizontal pursuit integration; full hold, MEMC off; playback loop resets to the saved first frame.
temporal_protocol.loop_boundary: Not a continuous loop; response/load history jumps from the final saved frame to the first saved frame.

profiles.name: generic_woled
profiles.label: WOLED / RGBW

settings.name: generic_woled
settings.description: Placeholder WOLED. Emission is per pixel (no zone grid). The WRGB mosaic is energy-preserving when box-filtered, so it does not change a flat color. ABL pulls the allowed peak down toward the full-field figure as APL rises. Spectral white-subpixel mixing beyond that mosaic is not modeled.
